subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting fork PR for this heartbeat prompt regression, or close/supersede that path and permit a new narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but the issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr/linked-pr-open and the only open closing-syntax fix is a conflicting fork PR, so automation should not create another repair until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path, then sponsor a focused same-repo fix with custom-prompt and transcript-boundary tests.

options.title: Refresh The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase it onto current main, add real behavior proof, and update tests for the current prompt boundary.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair work until a heartbeat-runtime owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork path, then sponsor a focused same-repo fix with custom-prompt and transcript-boundary tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the path-hint commit and the first maintainer fix attempt for the regression.
